:::{#def-x-intercept}
#### x-intercept

An **x-intercept** of a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f$ is an [input](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-argument) $x$ with $f(x) = 0$,
a point where the [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of $f$ crosses the horizontal axis.
A function can have no x-intercept, one, or many.

:::
